Possibly, but I need to know what happened before I can check. Eligibility depends on the reason code, and each code has its own rules and time window.

Please tell me which of these describes your situation:

- **Duplicate charge:** you were charged twice for the same purchase. TX-0401 and TX-0402 are both EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online, so this may apply.
- **Unauthorised card payment:** you did not make or approve the TechMart Online payment.
- **Unauthorised debit:** the money left your account without your authorisation by any means.
- **Goods not received:** you paid for an item and it never arrived.
- **Service not rendered:** you paid for a service that was not provided.

Once you tell me, I will run the eligibility check for that code. I will only open the dispute if it is eligible and you confirm.
